reason: I already reorder Toplux when it runs out and I have a drawer full of half-used bottles. $29.99 is more than what I pay now, so I'm not adding another one.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I don't need another supplement I'll stop taking after two weeks.
would_change_my_mind: A price close to what I pay now, around $19 to $20 for the 30 days, or a free first box so I can try it without risk.
